title: Meiosis I Products
text: During meiosis I, the primary oocyte divides unequally to produce a large secondary oocyte and a small first polar body.

title: Meiosis II Products
text: During meiosis II, the secondary oocyte divides to produce the ovum and a second polar body. The first polar body may also divide to produce a third polar body. Total: 3 polar bodies.
